channel.title: Asanka's Personal Blog
channel.description: Mental health writing, international student life in Australia, and practical resources.

item.title: Why Male International Students Don't Ask for Help
item.description: Why male international students stay silent when things go wrong — a Deer Park roundabout, the cost of the silence, and the free Australian help I wish I'd known about.

item.title: AI Became the First Person We Tell — Not the Last Resort
item.description: 29% of young people in NSW now use AI for mental health support. Why international students reach for a chatbot before a person — and where it breaks down.

item.title: 5 Things International Students Must Do When They First Arrive in Australia
item.description: An international student's honest guide to your first days in Australia: SIM cards, safety, the 48-hour work rule, tax, OSHC, and your wellbeing.

item.title: The Support List Every International Student in Australia Should Save
item.description: Free, confidential support services every international student in Australia should save: crisis lines, mental health, money, legal, and OSHC help.

item.title: The Phone Call That Saved My Life
item.description: A true story about international-student mental health in Australia: family pressure, the night I nearly gave up, and the phone call that saved my life.
